user.title: Reap
user.description:
Reap what you Sow.

Choose where tasks go and a starting point for your frost dates. You can adjust the dates on the next page.

data_description.todo_entity: Pick an existing to-do list, or let the planner create its own.
data_description.zone: Hardiness zones only roughly predict frost dates, so check them against local averages on the next page.

location.title: Frost dates and greenhouse
location.description: Crop timings are stored as days before or after your frost dates.

data.harden_off_days: Days to harden off before planting in beds
data.greenhouse_harden_off_days: Days to harden off before planting in the greenhouse
data.lookahead_days: Add tasks to the list this many days ahead
data.warm_last_frost: Last frost for warm crops (MM-DD, optional)

data_description.lookahead_days: Tasks further out stay in the planner until they come into view, so long succession sowings don't flood the list.
data_description.last_frost: Average date of the last frost in spring.
data_description.first_frost: Average date of the first frost in fall.
data_description.warm_last_frost: Tomatoes, peppers, squash and other frost-tender crops are timed from this date instead. Set it later than your last frost where spring stays cool for weeks afterwards. Leave empty to use the last frost.
data_description.offset_days: Negative for earlier, positive for later. Use this to fine-tune for a warm or cold garden.
data_description.profile: How quickly spring warms up after your last frost. This changes how early hardy crops go in and how long warm crops wait.

add_planting.title: Add a planting
add_planting.description: Pick what you want to grow.

planting_details.title: {crop}
planting_details.description: How and when to grow it. The fields start with this crop's defaults. Leave the optional ones empty to use the crop's usual window.

data.location: Plant out to, or sow in
data.save_defaults: Save as the default for this crop

data_description.start_date: Transplant date for indoor starts, or first sowing date for direct sowing. Empty means the start of the crop's window.
data_description.succession_days: Sow again every this many days. 0 means a single sowing.
data_description.succession_until: Last date for a repeat sowing. Empty means the end of the crop's window.
data_description.variety: Shown in task names, for example Sungold.
data_description.start_location: Where an indoor start grows until it's planted out, such as a seedling tray. You can set it later.
data_description.bought_starts: Bought as seedlings from a garden centre: a task to buy them about a week before planting out replaces sowing and potting up.
data_description.save_defaults: Next time you add this crop, the method, repeat interval, number of sowings, quantity and locations start with these values.

planting_confirm.title: {crop}: check the dates
planting_confirm.description:

add_crop.title: Add a crop or variety
add_crop.description: Enter the dates you'd usually do each step in your garden as month-day, such as 03-15, using the ones that apply. They repeat every year. To add a variety, copy timing from the crop it's a variety of and leave the dates empty.

data.name: Name
data.fall_direct_from: Direct sow or plant in fall from
data.fall_direct_to: Direct sow or plant in fall until

data_description.based_on: Optional. Starts from that crop's timing, icon and harvest.
data_description.frost_tender: Timed from the warm-crop frost date, like tomatoes and squash. A copy of a frost-tender crop is frost tender too.

add_planting.name: Add planting
add_planting.description: Plan a crop and add its tasks.

crop.name: Crop
crop.description: The crop's key, such as tomato or garlic. The List crops action lists every key.

method.name: Method
method.description: How it is grown. Defaults to the crop's default method.

year.name: Year
year.description: Growing year. Defaults to this year, or next year from September on.

season.name: Season
season.description: Which window to use when a crop has more than one, such as spring, summer or fall. Defaults to the first.

start_date.name: Start date
start_date.description: Transplant date for indoor starts, or first sowing date for direct sowing. Defaults to the start of the crop's window.

succession_days.name: Repeat every
succession_days.description: Sow again every this many days. 0 means a single sowing.

succession_until.name: Repeat until
succession_until.description: Last date for a repeat sowing. Defaults to the end of the crop's window.

variety.name: Variety
variety.description: Shown in task names, for example Sungold.

location.name: Location
location.description: Where it's planted out, or sown for direct sowing. For example Bed 3.

start_location.name: Start location
start_location.description: Indoor starts only: where it starts, such as a seedling tray, until it's planted out.

bought_starts.name: Bought as starts
bought_starts.description: Indoor methods only: bought as seedlings instead of sown, so there's a task to buy them instead of sowing and potting up.

preview_planting.name: Preview planting
preview_planting.description: Show the tasks a planting would create, without saving it.

add_plantings.name: Add plantings
add_plantings.description: Add several plantings at once. All are added, or none if one can't be scheduled.

plantings.name: Plantings
plantings.description: A list of plantings, each with the same fields as Add planting (crop is required).

use_defaults.name: Use crop defaults
use_defaults.description: Start each planting from its crop's saved defaults (method, repeat, quantity, location). Fields you give win.

copy_plantings.name: Copy plantings to another year
copy_plantings.description: Plan a year's plantings again with the same settings. Dates move by the same number of years.

planting_ids.name: Plantings
planting_ids.description: Only these plantings. Without it, every planting of that year is copied, except ones already planned for the new year.

remove_planting.name: Remove planting
remove_planting.description: Remove a planting and its open tasks.

planting_id.name: Planting ID
planting_id.description: From the Plantings sensor or the add planting response.

add_crop.name: Add crop
add_crop.description: Add a crop or variety, or override a built-in one.

key.name: Key
key.description: Lowercase id, for example tomato_sungold. Using a built-in key overrides that crop.

based_on.name: Based on
based_on.description: Copy windows and defaults from this crop, then apply the other fields.

windows.name: Windows
windows.description: List of windows with a season and ranges for indoor, direct, transplant and cover. Each range is two dates, either MM-DD for your garden or offsets like L-14 (14 days before last frost) and F+7 (7 days after first frost).

days_to_harvest.name: Days to harvest
days_to_harvest.description: From sowing, or planting for garlic and potatoes.

planted.name: Planted
planted.description: Grown from cloves, sets, tubers or slips, so tasks say Plant instead of Sow.

pot_up.name: Pot up
pot_up.description: Add a pot-up task for indoor starts.

icon.name: Icon
icon.description: A Material Design icon, such as mdi:chili-mild.

remove_crop.name: Remove crop
remove_crop.description: Remove a crop no planting uses. Built-in crops can be brought back with Reset crop.

list_crops.name: List crops
list_crops.description: Return the crops with their icons, methods, seasons and defaults.

sync.name: Sync
sync.description: Sync tasks with the task list now.

set_crop_defaults.name: Set crop defaults
set_crop_defaults.description: Set what a new planting of a crop starts with.

succession_days.name: Repeat every
succession_days.description: Default days between sowings. 0 means a single sowing.

start_location.name: Start location
start_location.description: Default start location for indoor starts.

bought_starts.name: Bought as starts
bought_starts.description: Buy this crop as seedlings by default instead of sowing it.

clear.name: Clear
clear.description: Go back to the built-in defaults.

update_planting.name: Update planting
update_planting.description: Change a planting. Empty values clear a field.

camera.name: Camera
camera.description: A camera that shows this location.

water.name: Watering
water.description: A valve or switch that waters this location. Reap remembers when it last ran.

update_location.name: Update location
update_location.description: Rename a location or change its sensors, light, camera or watering. Plantings follow a rename. An empty value clears one.
